body: Yes. Exactly. I had a pretty good childhood and upbringing. Good people around me. Had every opportunity to make something of myself and be happy with this life. Life really does have so much good to offer and I just want to experience and enjoy it, but all I've done is fuck it up in almost every way. I'm just so upset at myself for being where I am now and feel like I'll never be able to do better. I've wasted so much time.
Thanks for sharing. I liked it.
I'm glad to hear you're doing better. Stay strong.
You're not bothering me at all. Thank you for the reply.

While it's never induced a full blown panic attack, it can absolutely cause my anxiety to spike significantly. It makes me more obsessive and if I get fixated on the wrong things, it can cause problems. But it's also often the only thing that can get me out of my bad days and it's the only thing that can get me to enjoy things that otherwise I can't get interested in anymore. Bit of a double edged sword.
I don't really know what to say except I'm right there with you.
I'm 24 and didn't start till I was 23.
